raw_comment:
1.I notice that the coasts on the map have less intense droughts while the landlocked states in the center of the country have it the worst. While intensity is more extreme in the center, some states on the coast are still facing this problem.
2. I wonder why some spots are completely clear of the drought. I wonder this because these spots are seemingly all over the country. Some of these areas without drought are even near states that are facing very serious droughts.
I also wonder why Alaska seems to face no drought what’s so ever.
3. This applies to my life as I have family who live in west Texas and talk about the drought all the time. This is a serious problem this country is facing and it seems to be something most of the country has to deal with in some way shape or form.
4. Dry counties throughout the country.
